extensionDescription.message: AI-powered instant speech translation for all video meetings. Break language barriers with real-time voice translation.

clickToStart.message: Click "Open MAO Chat" below to start real-time translation.

quickStartInstructions.message: Configure your API key (OpenAI or Gemini) → Select "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" as microphone → Start speaking!

gatherTownGuidance.message: To use MAO Chat, please select "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings.

wherebyGuidance.message: To use MAO Chat, please select "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings and disable Noise reduction for better performance.

defaultGuidance.message: To use MAO Chat, please select "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings.

discordGuidance.message: To use MAO Chat, please select "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings and disable Noise Suppression in Discord's Voice settings for better performance.

slackGuidance.message: To use MAO Chat in Slack Huddles, please start a Huddle, then select "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" in your Video and Mic settings, and disable Noise Suppression in Audio & Video preferences for better performance.

teamsGuidance.message:
If you don't see the complete audio device list in Teams settings:
1) Temporarily disable the MAO Chat extension and refresh the page
2) Allow Teams to access your microphone and camera when prompted
3) Re-enable MAO Chat extension and refresh the page again
4) Allow MAO Chat to access your microphone when prompted.
Now you should see both real and "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" devices in your settings.

jitsiGuidance.message: To use MAO Chat in Jitsi Meet, open Settings > Devices and select "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" as your microphone. Then open Advanced audio settings and turn off Noise suppression, Echo cancellation, and Automatic gain control for clear translated audio.
